summary: Spell-cast shout text not centred over the caster
author: pm
body:
The spell-cast shout over a caster's head (for example "Recall!") sits left of centre. The user, 2026-11-25: "Spell text is very off compared to the original - not centered?" (screenshot .claude/scratch/coordinator/font_map/user_recall_offcenter.png).

Cause, found by the HH-0090 editor (not measured by the coordinator):  loating_text_manager.cpp:313-325 (HH-0084, commit 097b7a28) draws it in GameFont::Default (the Tahoma TTF), but centres it with the 3.82 width estimate of 4 px per character. For "Recall!" the estimate is 28 px, while Tahoma 12 px is about 35 px, so the text lands about 10 px left of centre.

**Done when:** the magic_cast_name branch centres with measure_text(GameFont::Default, text).width / 2, an in-client check shows the text centred over the head, and the build is clean.

Source: user report and HH-0090 editor analysis, 2026-11-25.
